Title: Succubus Club - Can you untap vampires?

Messages.Author: Anthony Barker
Messages.Body:
Can you trade someone else's vampire with the Succubus Club, untap it,
and then trade it back?
If so, you could make a tidy little profit by charging people to untap
their vampires for them...

Thanks in advance,
Anthony Barker (A.BA...@student.anu.edu.au)

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Anthony Barker <b930...@student.anu.edu.au> writes:
>Can you trade someone else's vampire with the Succubus Club, untap it,
>and then trade it back?
>If so, you could make a tidy little profit by charging people to untap
>their vampires for them...

Not without some external method for untapping during your untap
phase. Untapping the cards you control is the *first* thing that
happens during your untap phase - all other effects (incl. Succubus)
occur after the "untap cards you control" sub-phase. [VtES: 6.1]
